Wikidata's Q1440747 has no P94 and no P41, so the Commons fetch found nothing for this region. To act on this: check the Commons file's licence and currency and, if it stands, add it through choices.tsv or promote it by hand | resolved 2026-09-16: looked at, and the file stands. Despite its filename the picture is a coat of arms of the same family as the five Madagascar emblems Wikidata does name - a quartered shield of zebu head, rice, river valley and gemstone under a mural crown, over a motto ribbon - not a wordmark, so it is not the MG-71 case and masking its name leaves a picture. Current and free: uploaded 2019-10-07 by Privatemajory, who uploaded MG-32's and MG-33's arms, CC BY-SA 4.0, its only Commons category is Haute Matsiatra, and Commons holds no competing or later emblem for the region. Staged as emblem1 through choices.tsv, which is the one path that fetches a file Wikidata never named and survives the next fetch's prune; The file and its attribution row say it came from the English Wikipedia infobox, not from Wikidata. The text detector read the file and recorded no text at all, so the band FARITRA MATSIATRA AMBONY is painted by eight hand rows in masks.tsv; the motto does not name the region and is left
